chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: Water's Edge on Leaf Slime (M), then All Streams Flow to the Sea on Leaf Slime (S), killing both.
q2_other_line_considered: Shinobu — Sanctifying Ring followed by All Streams Flow to the Sea on one of the Leaf Slimes, for 4 Block while still killing one Leaf Slime.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up the 4 Block and area damage from Shinobu — Sanctifying Ring, and left 1 Energy unused.
q4_different_intent: Yes. If the Leaf Slimes had nonthreatening intents while unavoidable incoming attack damage made Block more valuable, I would have favored Shinobu — Sanctifying Ring plus one attack.
